description: This Java source file defines the ExtendedJpaTransactionManager class, which extends the Spring JpaTransactionManager to add custom transaction lifecycle callbacks, handle read-only transaction settings, and manage entity manager flush modes.

classes.name: ExtendedJpaTransactionManager
classes.description: A custom extension of JpaTransactionManager that adds support for transaction lifecycle callbacks and manages read-only transaction behavior.

methods.name: doBegin
methods.description: Overrides the doBegin method to set flush mode for read-only transactions and invoke lifecycle callbacks after beginning the transaction.

methods.name: doCommit
methods.description: Overrides the doCommit method to clear the entity manager for read-only transactions and invoke lifecycle callbacks after committing.

methods.name: isReadOnlyConnection
methods.description: Checks if the current database connection is marked as read-only.

methods.name: doCleanupAfterCompletion
methods.description: Ensures cleanup after transaction completion and triggers lifecycle callbacks.

methods.name: isReadOnlyTx
methods.description: Determines if the current transaction is marked as read-only.

methods.name: getCurrentEntityManager
methods.description: Retrieves the current EntityManager from the TransactionSynchronizationManager.

methods.name: invokeLifecycleCallbacks
methods.description: Executes all registered lifecycle callback functions.

methods.name: setLifecycleCallbacks
methods.description: Adds the provided list of TransactionLifecycleCallback instances to the callback list.
